Privacy information — draft

This development draft describes the intended local app behavior. It is not the final publisher policy. Publisher identity, support contact, effective date and launch countries must be completed before release.

Documents and reading preferences

Imported documents, notes, saved places and pace preferences are processed on your device. The app has no account, advertising, analytics or cloud document-sync service. The reader and dictionary are bundled. Native network verification is still pending.

Storage and backups

The iOS app stores its library in its app sandbox using iOS file protection. Files may be included in device backups under your Apple backup settings. This is not a promise of protection on an unlocked or compromised device.

Exported bookshelf backups contain document text, original PDFs, notes and settings in readable JSON. They are not password protected. Sharing a backup gives the chosen recipient or app access to its contents. The recipient's practices apply.

Deletion

Moving an item to Trash retains it. Delete permanently removes that reading and its original from this app's library. Erase all saved readings removes library data and reading preferences. Neither action deletes copies you exported or device backups. Reinstalling or restoring an older device backup may restore older data.

Support and external links

External links open only when selected. Those sites may receive network information such as your IP address and have separate privacy policies. A public support channel and its retention practices have not yet been selected. Do not send private books or notes in an unsolicited support message.

Apple services

Apple handles App Store distribution, device backups and any diagnostics you opt to share with Apple under its own settings and policies. Final App Store privacy disclosures must be checked against the signed build.
